_about: Localhost bridge between the VR player's own Minecraft client (Fabric mod) and their Blade & Sorcery (script mod). One row = one message. Frame: u32 length (big-endian) | u8 id | fields in order, big-endian. Units: Minecraft blocks = metres, Minecraft axes (+Z south, yaw 0 = +Z).

rows.name: Hello
rows.purpose: B&S mod announces itself and its protocol version

rows.name: Welcome
rows.purpose: Minecraft accepts; origin = block the B&S world anchor maps to

rows.name: StateDef
rows.rate: once per block state, before the first Section using it
rows.purpose: How to draw and collide one block state (shape ids in sheets/shapes.json); a texture name ending in #tint is coloured by the section's grass/foliage/water colour per the tint byte (1 grass, 2 foliage, 3 water)

rows.name: Texture
rows.purpose: PNG bytes of one block texture, read from the player's own Minecraft resources

rows.name: TextureRequest
rows.purpose: B&S asks for a texture it has not cached this session

rows.name: Section
rows.purpose: 16x16x16 blocks; states = 4096 big-endian u16 local palette indices, index order y*256+z*16+x, preceded by palette (u16 count, then i32 stateIds)

rows.name: SectionClear
rows.rate: when a section leaves the radius
rows.purpose: Drop the mesh and colliders of one section

rows.name: EntityState
rows.rate: 20 Hz per living entity within entityRadius
rows.purpose: A Minecraft mob or player near the VR player; flags 1=alive 2=player 4=hurt this tick 8=attacking

rows.name: EntityRemove
rows.rate: on despawn or out of range

rows.name: SelfState
rows.purpose: The VR player's own Minecraft body: authoritative health; teleportSeq rises when the server moves the player (respawn, /tp, correction) and B&S must move there

rows.name: Hurt
rows.purpose: The VR player's Minecraft body took damage; B&S plays the hit

rows.name: Pose
rows.purpose: Feet position, head yaw/pitch, grounded, hand offsets from the feet in the body frame (x right, y up, z forward); teleportSeq = last SelfState.teleportSeq B&S has applied (Minecraft ignores older poses)

rows.name: Hit
rows.rate: on hit, after damageCooldownMs per entity
rows.purpose: A B&S weapon or fist hit a proxy; dmgType ids in sheets/damage.json; v = weapon velocity in Minecraft axes
